entities.summary: Mauritz Sigvard Marjasin was a Swedish official and union official. He was chairman of the Swedish Municipal Workers' Union 1977–1988 and governor of Örebro County 1989–1994. He died of COVID-19 during the COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden.
